title: Rules & Regulations
intro: All participants must read, understand, and comply with these Rules & Regulations before taking part in The Social Hub Darts League.

blocks.text: All participants are required to read, understand, and comply with these Rules & Regulations prior to participation in any TSH Darts League competition.
By registering and competing within TSH Darts League, each player:

items: Confirms acceptance of all rules contained within this document
Agrees to abide by decisions made by TSH Administration
Acknowledges that all administrative decisions are final and binding

blocks.text: Failure to comply may result in disciplinary action, including removal from the league.
All players are considered registered for the full duration of the active season upon entry into TSH Darts League. Players agree to:

items: Complete the season where reasonably possible

blocks.text: If a player withdraws, becomes inactive, or is removed during a season:

items: This applies to future TSH competitions

blocks.text: This rule exists to protect league integrity and prevent disruption.
Players with active TSH Premium status are exempt from seasonal suspension resulting from withdrawal or inactivity. Premium players:

items: Will not receive a 1-season suspension for leaving or inactivity
May re-enter future competitions without restriction

blocks.text: However, Premium does NOT exempt players from cheating bans, match fixing penalties, misconduct sanctions, or administrative disciplinary action. These remain fully enforceable regardless of status.
TSH Administration reserves full discretion to:

items: Prevent abuse of the Premium system

blocks.text: All decisions are final.
Each player may hold only one TSH Darts League account. Duplicate sign-ups are not permitted.

items: Usernames must be unique and must not match another player's email
DartCounter display names must be unique
A player may not submit a second application while one is pending, or after they have been placed

blocks.text: If you already have an account, sign in instead of registering again. Contact TSH Administration if you need help accessing an existing account.
All players must link a correct DartCounter ID to their TSH profile. Failure to comply will result in:
Players are responsible for ensuring all account information is accurate.
All fixtures are published and managed exclusively via the official TSH website.
Both players share equal responsibility for arranging a mutually suitable fixture date and time within the designated match window (Sunday to Sunday). Players are required to:

items: Demonstrate reasonable and genuine efforts to complete fixtures within the allocated timeframe

blocks.text: A fixture shall only be deemed valid once formally confirmed via the TSH website:

items: The Home player must submit the fixture proposal
The Away player must accept the proposal

blocks.text: Fixtures not confirmed through the official platform will not be recognised under any circumstances.

Where a player can demonstrate reasonable and documented attempts to arrange a fixture, and the opposing player fails to respond or cooperate, TSH Administration reserves the right to award the match outcome accordingly.
Fixture extensions may be granted solely at the discretion of TSH Administration under exceptional circumstances.

items: Requests must be submitted prior to the original deadline

blocks.text: Once a match is scheduled, both players are expected to honour the agreed time and be ready to play. Players should only schedule matches when they are confident they can attend.
Players must provide at least 1 hour's notice if they need to cancel or request a reschedule.
Failure to do so may result in penalties.
If a player cancels or fails to show up within 1 hour of the scheduled match time:

items: The match may be recorded as a forfeit loss
The opponent may be awarded a default win
Rescheduling is only allowed at staff discretion

blocks.text: Repeated late cancellations will result in stricter punishment.
The following may be accepted as valid reasons for cancellation or rescheduling:
All reasons are subject to review by staff. If a pattern of misuse is identified, requests may be rejected regardless of reason.
Any attempt to abuse the cancellation system (including false excuses or repeated short-notice cancellations) will result in:
We expect all players to respect each other's time.
Players are expected to behave professionally and communicate clearly. Repeated failure to attend matches or respect scheduling rules may affect eligibility in future fixtures or leagues.
All decisions made by league staff are final. Exceptions may be made at their discretion depending on circumstances.

items: Competition Structure: Double Round Robin (each player plays every opponent twice — once home, once away)
Winning Requirement: First player to 5 legs
The Home player will throw first in the opening leg

blocks.text: 1 point is awarded per leg won. An additional 2 bonus points are awarded to the match winner.
Example — A 5–4 result awards:
Players must be ready to commence play at the agreed fixture time. A 10-minute grace period is permitted.
Where a player fails to attend within the permitted grace period:

items: The attending player is entitled to claim a 5–0 default victory
The attending player will be awarded 5 points (no bonus)
The absent player will receive 0 points

blocks.text: Players are assigned to divisions by TSH Administration based on:
All allocation decisions are final.

items: Top 2 players in each division will be promoted

blocks.text: TSH Administration reserves the right to adjust divisions where necessary.
The use of a camera is mandatory for all matches. Players must ensure:

items: The entire dartboard is clearly visible at all times
The camera provides a stable, unobstructed, high-quality view
All scoring is visible prior to dart removal

blocks.text: If any dart placement is unclear, the player must clearly indicate or physically touch the dart on camera before removal to confirm its scoring position. Failure to provide clear verification may result in the score being disputed.
Players are strongly encouraged to record all matches. Recordings:

items: May be requested in the event of disputes

blocks.text: Approved platforms:
Both players are responsible for accurate scoring and complete statistical recording.
Both players must submit:
All disputes, claims, or reports must be supported by verifiable evidence. TSH Administration will not act on unsupported claims. Acceptable evidence includes:
All match results and statistics must be submitted within 48 hours of match completion. Failure to comply may result in:
Players must:

items: Make reasonable efforts to arrange fixtures
Maintain respectful and professional conduct at all times

blocks.text: Failure to comply may result in disciplinary action.
Only fixtures confirmed via the official TSH website will be recognised. Any agreement outside the platform is invalid.
All players must compete honestly and fairly. Prohibited conduct includes:
Breaches may result in suspension or permanent removal.
All matches must be completed in full. If a player leaves a match without valid justification:

items: The match will be recorded as a 5–0 default loss
A disciplinary strike will be issued

blocks.text: Match pauses are permitted only for legitimate reasons such as emergencies or unavoidable interruptions. Players must notify their opponent before pausing.
Technical issues include:
All technical issues must be reported immediately during the match. Players must:

items: Raise the issue at the time it occurs

blocks.text: Issues reported after match completion may be rejected unless strong evidence is provided.
False or abusive claims of technical issues may result in disciplinary action.
TSH Darts League operates a zero-tolerance policy on cheating. This includes:
Players must strictly follow turn order and must not throw while their opponent is active. Sanctions may include warnings, strikes, forfeits, or removal.
Strikes may be issued for:

items: Failure to comply with league requirements

blocks.text: All players are expected to:

items: Uphold the integrity of the competition

blocks.text: Failure to do so may affect current and future eligibility.
TSH Administration reserves full authority to:
All decisions are final.
TSH Darts League reserves the right to amend or update these Rules & Regulations at any time. All changes will be communicated to participants.
These Rules & Regulations are established to ensure:
All participants are required to adhere to these principles at all times.
